_notes: The second region (DESIGN.md D94, C03). Its own catalogueVersion: the app keeps one
imported version per region, so bumping this number re-imports Argentina only.
'idPrefix' goes on every species id the build writes, because the species table is
shared with the Pacific region and a slug such as 'house-sparrow' exists in both.
Ecosystem ids carry the same prefix by hand, since they share a table too.
'sharesIdsWith' overrides the prefix for a species pacific.json already carries: it
takes the Pacific id, so one species is one row and a catch counts in both (D95).
The ecosystems follow the trip: Buenos Aires (pampas, delta, cities), Puerto Madryn
(coast, steppe), Bariloche and El Chaltén (Andean forest), El Calafate (steppe),
Mendoza (monte, high Andes), Salta (yungas, puna, monte) and Iguazú (Atlantic forest).
Version 2 pins photographs for the Argentine Hake and Darwin's Tree Iguana, whose
articles lead with a catch chart and a range map. Version 3 shares the 29 species
both regions list with the Pacific (D95).
